title: Accessibility and keyboard audit of editor chrome with proven-defect fixes
outcome: Core editor journeys (new/open/save, undo/redo, tool switching, zoom, panel navigation) are fully operable by keyboard and by screen-reader-meaningful labels: an audited findings report is committed, every proven accessibility defect found in existing chrome is fixed in place, and no layout or visual redesign is introduced.
before: GOVERNOR.md Release Gates require an accessibility pass on core editor journeys, and no accessibility audit evidence exists in docs/reviews/ or docs/research/. Existing chrome (index.html + src/chrome/**) has real handlers but no systematic audit of focus order, ARIA roles/labels, or keyboard reachability. Builder must audit first and fix only proven defects.
after: Committed audit report listing each journey, finding, severity and disposition; all proven defects fixed; keyboard-only walkthrough of the core journeys recorded; existing UI behavior for pointer users unchanged.
acceptance: Audit report committed with per-journey findings and dispositions (fixed / not-a-defect with reason).
Keyboard-only walkthrough of new/open/save, undo/redo, tool switch, zoom passes with visible focus.
All interactive controls expose accessible names/roles consistent with their real handlers; no decorative ARIA.
No pixel-level redesign; existing chrome/visual tests and a before/after screenshot pair show no unintended visual drift.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests, npm run test:chrome and npm run build pass.
evidence: Keyboard-only walkthrough evidence (Playwright keyboard-driven test or recorded run)
Before/after visual captures showing no unintended drift

builder.notes: Claimable after VIRO-0005 releases the tests/** lease.

critic.notes: User-visible chrome changes require critic review against the AAA brief with no layout invention.

delta.before: No accessibility audit evidence; unproven keyboard reachability.
delta.after: Committed audit, proven defects fixed, keyboard-only core journeys pass.
regression_protection: Existing chrome E2E and visual tests green
